pages.title: Enchantment Industry
pages.text: Create: Enchantment Industry turns experience into a fluid, **Liquid Experience**, and automates enchanting, disenchanting, and book copying with Create machines.

pages.title: Experience Hatch
pages.text: Right-click to store your own XP in it; sneak-click to take XP out. A [#](7A3C9A)[filter slot](entry://glossary/filter_slot)[#]() lets other mods' fluids count as XP.

Other XP sources:
- A Mechanical Grindstone over a Grindstone Drain crushes Experience Nuggets into liquid.
- [#](2E5AAC)[Crushing Wheels](entry://create_basics/crushing)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[Deployers](entry://create_basics/deployer)[#]() drop nuggets when they kill mobs.
- An **Experience Lantern** collects nearby orbs.

pages.title: Blaze Enchanter
pages.text: Acts as an enchanting table fed with Liquid Experience. Set the enchant level on its [#](7A3C9A)[panel](entry://glossary/value_panel)[#](). A template item limits the result to that item's enchantments.

pages.title: Blaze Forger
pages.text: Acts as an anvil with no repair cost. Merges enchantments, and can apply or extract them using Enchanting Templates.

pages.title: Printer
pages.text: Copies written books and enchanted books, names items, copies train schedules, clipboards and package addresses. Check [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() for recipes.

**Super enchanting:** feed a Blaze a Cake o' Enchanting and it goes past vanilla level limits.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** it comes with lightning strikes. Keep a Lightning Rod nearby.\
\
The Apotheosis blocks (Affix Augmentor, Gem Cutter, Blaze Composer) need Apotheosis, which is not in this pack.
